## Changes since `v0.5.3`

### Features

- turn off timestamps in the plain-text log to keep output lines bare, file logs in folders by separating the name template with / (up to 5 deep, with year, month and day variables) and have the log list and cleanup look inside them and remove folders left empty, and tick sessions on the Terminal Logs page, one, a shift-click range or all shown, to delete them together ([e2b12e5b](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e2b12e5b32c1a3d0c2b85ed908e654c264366b00))
- connect as usual when a session's log cannot start and say so instead of failing the connection, and open a tab's newest log from its menu with View Logs, matched by the logs the tab wrote since tTerm started or, for a restored SSH tab, by its id and connection since tab ids are reused across runs ([e9710afc](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e9710afcab5f705cdb6c5677f20cd16b6bf9d732))
- browse logged sessions on a Terminal Logs page opened from Settings > Logs, replay a raw log in a read-only terminal with play, seek, speed, idle skipping and search, read the plain-text log, export a session as an asciicast recording, show it in its folder or delete it, and save a terminal's text with its scrollback from the terminal menu ([3923bd2b](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3923bd2b7927223c2fcc0f7c4eeb629a54452e7f))
- log sessions per connection (always, never or follow settings) or start and stop logging a tab from its menu with a mark on recording tabs, stop logging keyboard input unless turned on, clean up old logs by age or total size touching only files tTerm wrote, and build the plain-text log from the screen so it keeps each line as it finally appeared, notes full-screen programs instead of their frames and keeps what a cleared screen showed ([f28f8585](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f28f8585edeaa23a838a4a8fe015bbd48ce5c2dd))
- show where WebDAV backups go under the remote folder field, the server URL with the folder appended, so a leading slash dropped on save no longer reads as moving the folder to the server root ([bb6a05a9](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/bb6a05a924bf06c74e370927d0e7afe2884bab9a))
- say when a WebDAV backup has downloaded before opening it in Import, delete the download once Import lets go of it or at the next start instead of keeping it until the next restore, and warn before importing settings that would switch this device to another WebDAV account, naming both accounts ([738ce852](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/738ce852e450effc029659b50898d1d9405dd1c2))
- open a backup restored from WebDAV with the saved backup password instead of asking for it again, falling back to the password field when it does not fit, and show which WebDAV backup and device it came from with a way back to the backup list, instead of an internal download path ([c62384a5](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c62384a5db5e7596227ed294cafaa0bec0e48e4b))
- list WebDAV backups in a scrolling box that always shows, with download, restore, delete and multi-select delete, and ask for the master password wherever saved passwords turn out to be locked, carrying on once unlocked, instead of failing with "Saved passwords are locked" and no way to unlock outside Settings > Security, which kept the WebDAV password from being saved and its backup list hidden ([8ae66c17](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/8ae66c17fedae7325dfe2c5a016589ae43157dba))

### Fixes

- show Codex's work and announce its turns again now that it runs sessions in a shared background server, whose hooks have no terminal to find: the hook then writes the report with the session's id to every terminal running Codex, and the tab Enter was typed in shortly before keeps the session while the others ignore it ([8418e504](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/8418e504a3fb2eadfa55b1fddcd1ee4e1761bcbd))
- free the GPU buffers of a hidden or closed terminal's WebGL renderer by showing its canvas at one pixel out of sight for a frame before losing the context, since WebKit skips resizing a lost context and keeps the last shown buffer until a later frame, so each released terminal held 100 to 150 MB until a garbage collection that could take hours ([3afae5da](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3afae5da5290559c398ffc0905faf39d48270761))
- offer to try the system credential store again or reset saved passwords when they stay locked in automatic mode, which had no way to unlock without a recovery password when the key was missing from the credential store or did not match the database, leaving saved passwords and WebDAV backup and sync unusable ([9435fa12](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/9435fa126ba0daf24729aaec4958f7c46da83dd7))
- close a tab's pooled SFTP connections when the tab closes, which kept the SSH connection and the server's sshd open for good, and reap idle connections every minute without closing one a transfer is still using, which an expiry triggered by another tab's connection used to cut off mid-way ([26648c7a](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/26648c7aa9b3f0a097c146eda05e011d0d767a60))
- hold back only the start of a color query in SSH output instead of every unterminated OSC sequence, which kept everything after a truncated title or a binary cat off the screen until a stray BEL arrived, and copied and rescanned a large inline image or OSC 52 clipboard on every packet, taking four seconds for two megabytes ([77740a8d](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/77740a8db50f65d8b2b7fee767a58b15cef5a984))

### Performance

- try WebGL again thirty seconds after a terminal loses its context, up to three times, instead of keeping a terminal that stays in sight on the canvas fallback, which keeps four full-size layers ([705392e3](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/705392e3c18d6e8e27feee410b783d089a6958dc))

### UI and usability

- mark an agent at work with a turning half-lit disc and one waiting on you with pause bars that ripple three times and then rest, animating only transform and opacity so the badges run on the compositor, since the waiting pulse animated a box-shadow that repainted every frame and cost about 15% CPU for as long as the agent waited, and a still waiting dot looked like a bell's ([b087e191](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/b087e19178e6de2b21ee01ad682f112b899b4271))
- explain what unlimited scrollback really means: history grows up to 10 million lines and is only freed by clearing, memory per line grows with window width, all tabs share one interface process that may crash and lose every tab's scrollback past the system limit, and session logging is the way to keep output long term ([e5d0ab90](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/e5d0ab90c81719e9bb9863614ba15e161e0f670a))

**Full comparison:** [v0.5.3...v0.5.4](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/compare/v0.5.3...v0.5.4)
